meta.methodology: Read framework.md, torah_70_packages.json, torah_70_additions.json, torah_70_ce_edges.json, and torah_70.txt. Collected all node IDs already assigned to packages (including additions). Identified all unique nodes appearing in cause/effect edges that are not yet assigned. Assigned each unassigned node to the existing package by its ESSENTIAL NATURE — asking 'what IS this concept at its core?' rather than 'what does it cause?' Polarity determined from the source text context.

assignments.reason: The essential nature of this node is humility — making oneself like dust. The source text (line 14) states: 'עַל־יְדֵי שִׁפְלוּת, שֶׁמֵּשִׂים עַצְמוֹ כְּעָפָר.' Humility/שפלות is the inner disposition that IS the dust-quality (עפר). The node's own text identifies it as 'making oneself like dust' — its essential nature is the human expression of the dust-concept. It belongs in Package 1 because at its core it IS the עפר quality experienced as a spiritual practice. In the eitza edges (1423), it serves as a CAUSE that produces the drawing force, but its NATURE is dust-humility, which is the domain of Package 1.

The essential nature of this node is self-diminishment — the collective expression of the same dust-humility as שפלות. The source text (line 14) states: 'מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהֵם מַמְעִיטִין וּמַקְטִינִים עַצְמָן, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה הֵם בִּבְחִינַת עָפָר.' The Rebbe explicitly says that self-minimization places one in the bechina of dust. While the CAUSAL direction is from self-diminishment to acquiring dust-quality, the ESSENTIAL NATURE of ממעיטין is the very same lowliness/humility that defines עפר. It is the communal form of שפלות. Belongs in Package 1 as the collective expression of the dust-nature.

assignments.node_id: יש לו כח המושך, להמשיך השם יתברך אצלו, שזהו בחינת המשכן כנ"ל
assignments.node_text: יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ, לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ אֶצְלוֹ, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כַּנַּ"ל
assignments.reason: This node's text explicitly identifies its own essential nature: it IS the drawing force (כח המושך) and it IS the bechina of the Mishkan. The phrase 'שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן' within the node text itself declares it to be the same essence as two core Package 1 nodes (כח המושך and משכן). This is a longer-form expression of concepts already at the heart of Package 1. Its essential nature is drawing-force-as-divine-indwelling. Belongs in Package 1 without question.

The essential nature of this node is the act of giving charity specifically to the tzaddik who is the bechina of dust. The source text (line 7) describes this as 'בְּחִינַת זְרִיעָה עַל הֶעָפָר' — a bechina of sowing upon the earth. The act of giving to the tzaddik IS, in its essential nature, sowing upon dust — the same dust-domain that defines Package 1. The Rebbe does not treat צדקה here as a general concept of charity; it is specifically charity-to-the-dust-tzaddik, which makes it an action whose identity is defined entirely by the dust/tzaddik/drawing-force cluster. Its nature belongs to the domain of Package 1.

The essential nature of this node is immediate blessing — the fruit that grows from the dust. The source text (line 7) frames this through 'וְעַפְרוֹת זָהָב' (Job 28:6) — dust-of-gold, meaning all divine abundance flows from the dust-quality. The blessing IS the gold-aspect of the dust; it is what the drawing force draws. In the Torah's single conceptual domain, blessing is not a separate thematic family — it is the natural expression of the dust-tzaddik-drawing-force reality. The verse 'זִרְעוּ לָכֶם לִצְדָקָה וְקִצְרוּ לְפִי חָסֶד' (Hosea 10:12) frames blessing as the harvest of what is sown on dust. Its essential nature is the abundance-aspect of the dust/drawing-force domain. Belongs in Package 1.

stats.notes: Torah #70 is a structurally unified teaching with a single conceptual domain. All 7 unique nodes from the 4 cause/effect edges belong to the same thematic family: the tzaddik-as-dust and its drawing force. Two nodes (משכן, עפר) were already assigned to Package 1 via the bechina packages. The remaining 5 nodes — two humility-concepts (שפלות and ממעיטין), one expanded drawing-force description, one charity-action, and one blessing-result — all share the essential nature of the dust/drawing-force domain and are assigned to Package 1. No new packages were needed. No nodes remain unassigned.
